summary: 50-foot pole L-4 tower on St. Joe National Forest, built in 1934 and destroyed in 1951; drive-up, and no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Both sources agree on the 1934 build and 1951 destruction. No staffing history in either source. Access is marked public from National Forest land and the drive-up tag; no source says so directly. Height 15.2 m is 50 feet converted, and the sources give no separate total height. No new photos; the existing record photo is from idahofirelookouts.com.
